conventions.layout: One titled card per asset. Field order may vary. Each card has a local Notes list; a note labelled GLOBAL may instead appear in document_footer. Combining two asset titles in one card or duplicating the same asset into multiple cards is format drift.
conventions.meaning: Installed is installation year. Technician is current responsible person. Local Notes are work performed on that asset; GLOBAL advice applies to all assets.

state.source_evidence: Pump A was installed in 2020. R. Fen is responsible for it; its seal was replaced. Valve B entered service in 2021 under L. Orin; its pressure was inspected. Global advice: isolate power before servicing.

status.instructions: Classify the extracted chapter tables or maintenance cards against the explicit conventions and source evidence. Evaluate meaning and attachment, not just structural validity. Use only supplied evidence. A fused header with correct paired values is format-only; wrong source values or attachments are semantic defects. Incomplete/ambiguous evidence without an established defect means uncertain. Return one class.

criteria.conformant: The text and row ownership match source evidence and explicit document-local conventions; allowed layout variations are not defects.
criteria.format_drift: A documented table/header/layout convention is violated, but no row value, meaning or attachment contradicts source evidence.
criteria.row_semantic_issue: A row value, meaning or note attachment contradicts source evidence, while table/header/layout conventions are satisfied.
criteria.mixed: Both a table/header/layout convention violation and a source-supported row value, meaning or attachment defect are present.
criteria.uncertain: Evidence or explicit conventions are insufficient or ambiguous to establish whether this chapter is conformant or defective.
